title.en: Outdoor timber staircase with storage beneath

alt.tr: Fayans zeminli avluda, altı kapaklı ahşap kaplamayla kapatılmış çapraz korkuluklu merdiven
alt.en: Cross-braced timber staircase in a tiled courtyard, its underside closed in timber boarding with a door

caption.tr: Merdivenin altı ahşap kaplamayla kapatılıp kapaklı bir depoya dönüştürülmüş.
caption.en: The space under the staircase is closed in with timber boarding and fitted with a door for storage.
